literal: One-sidedly is painful love, carrying pole like, on both sides also is sweet.
translation: Love is painful when it is one-sided; like a carrying pole, it is sweet only when balanced on both sides.
modern: காவடித் தண்டு இரு பக்கமும் சமமாக இருந்தால் தான் சுமக்க இனிமையாக இருக்கும்; அதுபோல, காதலும் இரு பக்கமும் இருந்தால் தான் இன்பம் தரும், ஒரு பக்கமாக மட்டும் இருந்தால் துன்பம் தரும்.
explanation: In this couplet, the poet compares love to a carrying pole ('கா'), which is used to carry loads balanced on both ends. If a carrying pole is loaded on only one side ('ஒருதலையான்'), it becomes unbalanced and painful ('இன்னாது') to carry. Similarly, love that is one-sided brings only grief and suffering to the person who feels it. Love becomes sweet ('இனிது') and harmonious only when it is mutual and shared equally by both partners ('இருதலையானும்'), just like a perfectly balanced carrying pole.
